findings.motion: Roll call 73: cloture on Husted Amdt. 4732 to S. 1383
findings.note: Senate roll call 73. Moran voted yea on cloture for an amendment to require voters to provide photo identification. Motion rejected 53-47.

findings.motion: Roll call 96: waive budget rules, Kennedy Amdt. 5414 to S.Con.Res. 33
findings.note: Senate roll call 96. Moran voted yea on a motion to waive budget rules for an amendment giving reconciliation instructions on ID requirements for voter registration, photo ID for voting, and election day and ballot counting. Motion rejected 48-50.

findings.motion: Roll call 144: waive budget rules, Graham Amdt. 5779 to S. 2
findings.note: Senate roll call 144. Moran voted yea on a motion to waive budget rules for an amendment to ensure only citizens are registered to vote in federal elections and to require photo ID from voters. Motion rejected 48-50.

findings.motion: Roll call 151: waive budget rules, Lee Amdt. 5804 to S. 2
findings.note: Senate roll call 151. Moran voted yea on a motion to waive budget rules for an amendment to ensure only citizens are registered to vote in federal elections and to require photo ID from voters. Motion rejected 50-49.

findings.motion: Roll call 231: cloture on motion to proceed to S. 5271
findings.note: Senate roll call 231. Moran voted yea on cloture on the motion to proceed to S. 5271, a bill to amend the Help America Vote Act of 2002 to require voters to provide photo identification. Motion rejected 52-46.
